title: Contact
lead: Tell me about the role or the project. Your message is saved in your browser the moment you send it and goes on to me from there, even when my chat server is slow to wake up.

email.label: Email
email.hint: So I can reply. I won't share it or add it to any list.

message.label: Message
message.hint: A few lines is plenty: the role or project, and anything you'd like me to know.
message.placeholder: Hi Sudhi, we're hiring a backend developer for…

form.privacy: Your message stays in this browser until it reaches me, then for five days so you can come back to the conversation.

errors.nameTooShort: Your name needs at least 2 characters.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.messageTooShort: Your message needs at least 10 characters.
errors.messageTooLong: Please keep your message under 4,000 characters.
errors.tooFast: That was very quick. Please check your message, then send it again.

status.openChat: Open the chat in a new tab

received.title: Message received
received.body: I've got your message and will reply to {{email}}. The live chat isn't available right now; if it starts while you're here, it will open below.

stalled.title: The chat server is still down
stalled.bodyPending: I'll keep trying every few minutes, and again the next time you visit. If it's urgent, email me or send me a message on LinkedIn.
stalled.bodyFailed: It hasn't reached me yet, so please email me or send me a message on LinkedIn. I'll keep trying the chat in the background.

waking.title: Saved. Waiting for the chat server
waking.body: My chat server sleeps when nobody is using it and can take a minute to start. Your message is safe in this browser and will send on its own, so you can keep browsing the site.

delivered.title: Message delivered
delivered.body: Thanks, {{name}}. I'll reply here or by email, and you can keep chatting below.

failed.title: This message couldn't be sent
failed.body: The chat server refused it. Please email me instead and I'll pick it up from there.

notFound.title: This conversation has ended
notFound.body: Conversations are kept for five days. You can send a new message.

emailedInstead.title: Sent by email instead
emailedInstead.body: Your browser wouldn't let the site save your message, so it came to me by email. I'll reply to {{email}}.

storageBlocked.title: Your browser blocked saving the message
storageBlocked.body: This can happen in private browsing. Please email me directly and I'll reply from there.

elsewhere.location: I'm in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala (India Standard Time, UTC+5:30).
